Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
There are a number of Praxis Siezure cards that increase the capacity of a
vampire of a specific clan, if the vote is successlful. Specifically PS:
Brussels does this for Nosferatu.

My question:

Suppose Nikolaus Vermeulen, who is already Prince of Brussels, should call
a vote PS: Brussels to declare himself Prince of Brussels all over again.
Presumably this will have no effect on his title: He loses his old title
and gains an identical new title. Question is: does his capacity
increase by 1?

Can he continue to call PS: Brussels until his capacity reaches ridiculous
proportions?

Thanks

John W.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Whelan <jbwh...@amanda.dorsai.org> wrote:
> There are a number of Praxis Seizure cards that increase the capacity of a
> vampire of a specific clan, if the vote is successful. Specifically PS:

> Brussels does this for Nosferatu.
>

> Suppose Nikolaus Vermeulen, who is already Prince of Brussels, should call
> a vote PS: Brussels to declare himself Prince of Brussels all over again.
> Presumably this will have no effect on his title: He loses his old title
> and gains an identical new title. Question is: does his capacity
> increase by 1?

Yes, by card text.

> Can he continue to call PS: Brussels until his capacity reaches ridiculous
> proportions?

No. Each new successful PS causes the loss of the old title.
When you lose a capacity-giving title, you lose the capacity as well.
